response.justification: Bogdan brings genuine Staff-level distributed systems experience (micro-services handling millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby) and is currently hands-on building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling at re:cinq, which aligns well with the role's AI-native mindset. However, Python is a stated must-have and never appears anywhere in his skills or work history, which is a significant technical gap, and the resume lacks explicit evidence of stakeholder management, on-call/incident response, or agile ceremony participation.
strengths: Currently building AI-agent infrastructure and agentic workflow tooling (MCP), directly matching the AI-native engineering mindset required
Proven high-throughput distributed systems experience handling millions of requests/sec with async I/O, caching, and fibers
Broad, deep systems thinking across many languages/platforms (web, mobile, embedded, desktop) over a 15+ year career
concerns: No mention of Python anywhere in skills or experience, despite it being an explicit must-have
No explicit evidence of stakeholder management, cross-functional coordination, or product-facing decision-making
No clear mention of on-call rotations, operational monitoring ownership, or formal agile/scrum ceremony experience
